implementation_question: What should stay where it is?
current_answer: ControlsWithStoreSubscription stays inside the selected/supported path.
source_evidence: The file already comments that ControlsWithStoreSubscription is split to avoid a store subscription on every block; it reads editorStore state, block editing mode, pattern source registration, synced/unsynced pattern state, and metadata bindings.
required_patch_contract: The patch does not hoist editorStore or blockEditingMode reads into the outer HOC; they remain behind both selected and supported gates.
required_test_contract: The selected-unsupported test asserts one support-check useSelect call and no useBlockEditingMode call, so the store-backed controls path does not mount.

implementation_question: Why is this safe for unselected blocks?
current_answer: Unselected blocks already show no pattern override controls.
source_evidence: The current render condition is props.isSelected && isSupportedBlock; moving the support check into a child mounted by props.isSelected preserves the visible condition.
required_patch_contract: For unselected blocks, render only BlockEdit. When a block becomes selected, mount the child and read current settings at that time.
required_test_contract: The selection-transition test renders unselected with no useSelect calls, then rerenders selected and verifies the controls appear.

implementation_question: How should settings changes be handled?
current_answer: Only selected blocks need live support-setting updates.
source_evidence: The support setting is read from block-editor settings and depends on props.name. An unselected block can read fresh settings when it is selected later.
required_patch_contract: The selected-only child keeps useSelect subscribed while selected, with props.name as dependency; no cache outlives block-name or settings changes.
required_test_contract: The selected-settings test mutates __experimentalBlockBindingsSupportedAttributes and rerenders while selected, then verifies the support result toggles on.

implementation_question: What is the least invasive test seam?
current_answer: Export the HOC as a named export while keeping the side-effect filter registration unchanged.
source_evidence: packages/editor/src/hooks/index.js imports the hook module only for its addFilter side effect, and withPatternOverrideControls is currently not exported.
required_patch_contract: The patch exports withPatternOverrideControls directly and still passes that same HOC to addFilter( 'editor.BlockEdit', ... ).
required_test_contract: Focused unit coverage now covers selected supported, selected unsupported, unselected supported, selection transition, settings change while selected, and the unsynced reset path.
